title: Occupation
description: A sealed, identified entry of the world catalog: a market group, market, work, occupation group or occupation. The whole id is its identity.
x-description-zh-CN: 世界目录里一个封存的、有标识的条目：赛道组、赛道、工作、职业大类或职业。整个 ID 就是它的身份。

id.description: The whole id is the identity; it is never rebuilt from a label or a path.
id.x-description-zh-CN: 整个 ID 是身份，不根据名称或路径重新生成。

kind.description: Which concept class the entry is. Decides the type; never guessed from the id.
kind.x-description-zh-CN: 条目属于哪个概念类。类型由它决定，不从 ID 里猜。

tasks.description: Tasks of the occupation in the catalog (O*NET).
tasks.x-description-zh-CN: 目录（O*NET）中该职业的任务数。

touched_tasks.description: Tasks covered by at least one kind of work that a published update was linked to. Says what was collected, not what AI can do.
touched_tasks.x-description-zh-CN: 至少被一项有已发布更新关联的工作覆盖的任务数。说的是采集到了什么，不是 AI 能做什么。

markets.description: Markets the occupation serves: market id, confidence and status of the machine-proposed edge.
markets.x-description-zh-CN: 该职业服务的赛道：赛道编号及机器提出的边的置信度与状态。
